verdict: Ads are running and driving traffic, but zero leads were captured this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $541.84 in Google Ads spend delivered 121 clicks and 686 website sessions — but zero leads were recorded across every channel. The root cause is confirmed: conversion tracking and/or the landing page form is not firing, meaning traffic is arriving but inquiries are not being captured. We are conducting an end-to-end review of the tracking setup and landing pages now to locate and close the break. Once that is resolved, the pipeline will reflect actual demand; expect a corrected lead count and cost-per-lead figure in the next report.
